long_biography.plain_text:
Insurance has framed Michael T. Gray's working life for more than three decades. Educated at Southern Methodist University and Tulane University, he became an operator and industry representative, including chairing Louisiana's insurance guaranty association. With his brother Eric, he also launched an in-house robotics team that completed the 2005 DARPA Grand Challenge after building an autonomous vehicle amid Hurricane Katrina's disruption.

As executive chairman of Tiberius Acquisition Corporation, Gray led the insurance-focused acquisition company into its combination with International General Insurance in 2020. He remained an IGI director and shareholder. Within the family group, he also guided ventures in title insurance, oil and gas, software and property alongside its core commercial casualty business.
